c: Prep. Peel lukanka casing, slice thinly on a bias; keep chilled.
Cheese. Cut sirene into 2 cm cubes; slice kashkaval into thin triangles.
Pickles. Drain mixed pickles, cut larger pieces into bite size.
Service. Take out 10 min before serving so cheese and lukanka reach full flavour.
Plating. Wooden board: fanned lukanka, sirene drizzled with olive oil and paprika, kashkaval triangles, lyutenitsa and pickles in ramekins, parsley sprigs.
e912c418.st: Sliced lukanka and cheeses: 24 h at 0–4 °C, covered; vacuum 72 h Opened lyutenitsa and pickles: 5 days at 0–4 °C

c: Prep. Shape mince into 160 g patties, chill; mix lyutenitsa with mayonnaise; slice tomatoes and gherkins.
Onion. Cook sliced red onion slowly in butter with sugar 25–30 min until soft and golden.
Grill. To order: season patty, grill with a little oil 3–4 min per side, core ≥ 75 °C.
Melt. Top patty with kashkaval for the last minute under a cloche; toast bun cut sides.
Assemble. Base bun, lyutenitsa mayo, romaine, tomato, patty with kashkaval, onion, gherkins, mayo, top bun.
Plating. Wooden board or flat plate: burger held with a skewer, side of green salad or fries alongside, extra mayo in a ramekin.
8e6d244e.st: Raw patties: 24 h at 0–2 °C between parchment, or frozen 1 month at −18 °C Caramelised onion and lyutenitsa mayo: 72 h at 0–4 °C

c: Sear. Dust oxtail with flour, brown hard in olive oil; remove. Sweat onion, carrot, celery, garlic; fry tomato paste 2 min.
Braise. Deglaze with red wine, reduce by half; add tomatoes, stock, bay, thyme, oxtail. Cover, 160 °C 3–3.5 h until falling off bone.
Pick. Strip meat, discard bones and fat; reduce sauce to coating, return meat, season. Portion 150 g.
Cook. To order boil linguine in salted water 1 min under al dente.
Toss. Heat ragout with a splash of pasta water, add linguine and butter, toss to glossy emulsion.
Plating. Twirl into a warm deep pasta bowl, spoon meat on top; finish with grated parmesan and chopped parsley.
65c010b1.st: Oxtail ragout: 72 h at 0–4 °C; vacuum-packed portions frozen −18 °C 3 months Grated parmesan, chopped parsley: 24 h at 0–4 °C

c: Purée. Blend black garlic with olive oil, water and lemon juice until smooth; pass through a sieve.
Par-cook. Sweat onion in olive oil, toast rice, deglaze with wine; add hot stock gradually 12 min. Spread thin on a tray, chill fast.
Finish. To order: 90 g par-cooked rice with hot stock 6 min; off heat beat in butter, parmesan and half the purée.
Shrimp. Sauté in olive oil with sliced garlic and chilli 2 min until just opaque, core ≥ 63 °C; finish with butter and parsley.
Plating. Pour risotto into a warm shallow bowl, tap flat; shrimp on top, dots of black garlic purée, parsley.
1c4f9d71.st: Par-cooked risotto: 48 h at 0–4 °C, covered Black garlic purée: 5 days at 0–4 °C Raw peeled shrimp: 24 h at 0–2 °C on ice; or frozen until use

c: Prep. Wash and dry romaine, tear into large pieces; shave Parmesan; chill.
Dressing. Blend mayonnaise, Parmesan, anchovy, garlic, lemon juice, mustard, water and pepper until smooth.
Croutons. Cube bread, toss with olive oil, crushed garlic and salt; bake 180 °C 8 min until golden.
Chicken. Season with salt, pepper, garlic and olive oil; to order grill 5–6 min per side; core ≥ 75 °C; rest, slice.
Dress. Toss romaine with dressing until evenly coated.
Plating. Wide pasta bowl: dressed romaine, warm sliced chicken fanned on top, croutons scattered, Parmesan shavings, cracked black pepper.
f3770ea6.st: Caesar dressing: 72 h at 0–4 °C Marinated raw chicken: 24 h at 0–4 °C Croutons: 48 h airtight at room temperature

c: Prep. Butterfly chicken breasts, season, brush with olive oil; slice tomatoes, wash and dry romaine.
Grill. Grill chicken 4–5 min per side, core ≥ 75 °C; rest 3 min and slice.
Bacon. Bake bacon on a tray at 190 °C 10–12 min until crisp; drain on paper.
Toast. To order: toast three slices of bread, butter lightly, spread with mayonnaise.
Assemble. Layer romaine, tomato and chicken; second slice; bacon, tomato, romaine; top slice. Press, trim crusts optional.
Plating. Flat plate: sandwich cut into four triangles secured with picks, standing upright, side of green salad or fries in the centre.
438e7d76.st: Grilled chicken: 48 h at 0–4 °C after blast chilling; cooked bacon: 48 h at 0–4 °C Sliced tomatoes and washed romaine: 24 h at 0–4 °C

c: Prep. Soak porcini in warm water 30 min, chop, strain liquid; dice chicken, vegetables and mushrooms.
Sauté. Sweat onion, carrots, celery and garlic in butter; add mushrooms and porcini, cook 5 min.
Simmer. Add rinsed barley, chicken, stock, porcini liquid, bay leaf and herbs; simmer 40 min, core ≥ 75 °C.
Croutons. Cube rye bread, toss with olive oil, garlic and salt; bake 160 °C 10–12 min until crisp.
Service. Remove bay leaf, season, finish with chopped parsley; reheat portion to ≥ 75 °C to order.
Plating. Warm soup bowl on underplate: soup ladled in, croutons served on the side in a ramekin, parsley on top.
2d3e4d07.st: Soup: 48 h at 0–4 °C after blast chilling; frozen 1 month at −18 °C Croutons: 3 days airtight at room temperature

c: Pancetta. Cut lardons, render in butter until crisp; drain, keep fat.
Base. Sweat onion and garlic in the fat, deglaze with white wine, reduce; add stock and half the peas, simmer 3 min, blend smooth.
Sauce. Add cream, reduce to coating; stir in parmesan, whole peas, pancetta, chopped mint; season. Portion 160 g.
Cook. To order boil penne in salted water to al dente.
Toss. Warm sauce, add penne and a splash of pasta water; toss until glossy, adjust consistency.
Plating. Warm deep pasta bowl, penne piled high, a few crisp lardons and peas on top; shaved parmesan, black pepper.
be5d7672.st: Pea & pancetta sauce: 48 h at 0–4 °C, covered Crisp pancetta: 72 h at 0–4 °C

c: Marinate. Split wings at joint; mix with yoghurt, grated garlic, paprika, salt and pepper; 12 h at 0–4 °C.
Dip. Mix sour cream, chopped dill, garlic, lemon juice and salt; chill.
Coat. To order, toss drained wings in flour and corn starch mix; shake off excess.
Fry. Deep-fry at 170 °C for 9–10 min until deep golden; core ≥ 75 °C.
Rest. Drain 1 min on rack, season lightly with salt.
Plating. Paper-lined basket or oval plate: wings piled, dill sprig on top, sour cream dip in ramekin alongside.
98e01005.st: Marinated raw wings: 24 h at 0–4 °C Sour cream dip: 48 h at 0–4 °C

c: Prep. Slice pork loin into 110 g escalopes, pound to 8 mm, season; flour, egg wash, breadcrumbs.
Dressing. Blend mayonnaise, grated Parmesan, anchovy, lemon juice, Dijon mustard, garlic and pepper.
Fry. To order: shallow-fry in sunflower oil 2–3 min per side until golden, core ≥ 68 °C; drain.
Toast. Split ciabatta and toast cut sides; shred romaine, slice tomatoes, shave Parmesan.
Assemble. Dressing on both halves, romaine, tomato, crispy pork, more dressing and Parmesan; close.
Plating. Rectangular board or plate: sandwich cut diagonally, secured with picks, side of green salad or fries alongside.
55abd8d3.st: Breaded pork: 24 h at 0–4 °C on parchment, or frozen raw 1 month at −18 °C Caesar dressing: 3 days at 0–4 °C

c: Béchamel. Cook butter and flour 2 min, whisk in hot milk, simmer 5 min; season with salt and nutmeg. Cool covered.
Prep. Grate Gruyère; portion ham 50 g and bread 2 slices per sandwich.
Assemble. To order: butter outside of bread, spread mustard and thin béchamel inside, layer ham and half the Gruyère, close.
Toast. Griddle both sides golden, 2 min each, on medium heat.
Gratinate. Top with béchamel and remaining Gruyère; bake 220 °C 5–6 min until bubbling and browned.
Madame. Fry one egg sunny side up in sunflower oil, yolk runny; place on top of the sandwich.
Plating. Cut diagonally on a warm rectangular plate, halves overlapping; side in a ramekin or small bowl alongside.
f97d8a33.st: Béchamel: 48 h at 0–4 °C, film on surface Grated Gruyère, portioned ham: 72 h at 0–4 °C, covered Madame = Monsieur + one fried egg (MADAME OPTION); nutrition of the egg is extra.

c: Prep. Cut kashkaval into 1.5 cm thick batons of 120 g per portion; keep chilled.
Breading. Coat in flour, beaten egg, breadcrumbs; repeat egg and crumb for a sealed double coat.
Chill. Rest breaded pieces 30 min at 0–4 °C so coating sets and cheese stays firm.
Fry. To order, deep-fry at 175 °C for 1.5–2 min until golden; drain on paper.
Plating. Slate or wooden board: kashkaval pané stacked off-centre, cranberry jam in small ramekin alongside; serve immediately.
b61eb5d5.st: Breaded kashkaval: 48 h at 0–4 °C; frozen −18 °C 1 month, fry from frozen Cranberry jam: opened, 14 days at 0–4 °C

c: Pesto. Blanch basil 5 s, ice; blend with pistachios, parmesan, garlic, lemon juice and salt, stream in olive oil. Keep bright green, chilled.
Crumble. Toast finishing pistachios 160 °C 6 min, chop coarsely.
Cook. To order boil spaghetti in salted water to al dente.
Toss. Off the heat, toss spaghetti with pesto and a splash of pasta water; never boil the pesto.
Burrata. Temper burrata 20 min at room temperature, cut 60 g pieces just before service.
Plating. Nest spaghetti in a warm wide bowl, burrata on top, scatter pistachio crumble, basil leaf, olive oil drizzle, cracked pepper.
59417f9f.st: Pistachio pesto: 72 h at 0–4 °C, oil layer and film on surface; frozen −18 °C 1 month Burrata: in brine at 0–4 °C, use by supplier date, 24 h once opened

c: Roast. Char whole peppers at 220 °C 20–25 min, cover 10 min, peel and deseed; tear into strips.
Dressing. Mix cider vinegar, crushed garlic, sugar, salt and pepper; whisk in olive oil.
Marinate. Toss warm peppers with half the dressing and chopped parsley; chill at least 1 h.
Prep. Toast walnuts at 160 °C 6 min; halve cherry tomatoes; crumble sirene.
Service. Dress arugula and tomatoes lightly with remaining dressing to order.
Plating. Flat plate: marinated peppers in the centre, arugula and tomatoes alongside, crumbled sirene and walnuts on top, parsley.
090d3882.st: Marinated peppers: 48 h at 0–4 °C, covered Dressing: 3 days at 0–4 °C; toasted walnuts: 7 days airtight, dry store

c: Fry. To order fry from frozen at 175 °C, 3–4 min, until golden and crisp.
Season. Drain well, salt immediately while hot; 150 g per portion.
Plating. Lined ramekin or cone on the sandwich plate, served at once.
14c75bd5.st: Fries: frozen −18 °C until frying; never refreeze Fryer oil: filter daily, change by TPM test

c: Prep. Wash and spin lettuce; halve cherry tomatoes, slice cucumbers 3 mm. Keep chilled separately.
Dressing. Whisk olive oil, lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Service. To order toss 80 g salad with dressing at the last moment.
Plating. Small bowl on the sandwich plate, beside the sandwich.
c12db6b6.st: Washed lettuce, cut vegetables: 24 h at 0–4 °C, covered Dressing: 72 h at 0–4 °C

c: Prep. Devein shrimp, pat dry; slice garlic thinly, chop chilli and parsley; keep chilled.
Mousse. Blend avocado, strained yoghurt, lime juice and salt until silky; pipe-bag, cling film on surface.
Sticks. Cut sourdough into 1.5 cm sticks, brush with olive oil, salt; bake 180 °C 8–10 min until crisp.
Sauté. To order, warm olive oil with garlic and chilli until golden; add shrimp, sauté 1–2 min per side.
Finish. Deglaze with white wine, reduce; add lemon juice, parsley, salt and pepper; shrimp core ≥ 63 °C.
Plating. Warm shallow bowl: avocado mousse quenelle off-centre, shrimp alongside with pan oil, two bread sticks leaning across, parsley on top.
f9a484bd.st: Avocado mousse: 12 h at 0–4 °C, cling film on surface Raw shrimp mise en place: 24 h at 0–4 °C; frozen −18 °C 3 months Bread sticks: 48 h airtight at room temperature

c: Quinoa. Rinse, simmer in salted water 12–14 min, drain, spread on a tray and chill to 4 °C.
Dressing. Whisk lemon juice, honey, Dijon mustard, salt and pepper; emulsify with olive oil.
Prep. Halve cherry tomatoes, dice cucumbers, slice red onion thinly, chop parsley; keep chilled.
Shrimp. To order: sauté with olive oil and sliced garlic 2–3 min until opaque, core ≥ 63 °C; season.
Assemble. Toss quinoa, vegetables, parsley and arugula with dressing; slice avocado to order.
Plating. Wide salad bowl: dressed quinoa and greens as base, fanned avocado on one side, warm shrimp on top, drizzle remaining dressing.
a62f15eb.st: Cooked quinoa and cut vegetables: 24 h at 0–4 °C, covered Dressing: 3 days at 0–4 °C; raw shrimp: 24 h at 0–2 °C or frozen −18 °C

c: Blind bake. Line 26 cm tart ring with pastry, chill 20 min, bake with beans 180 °C 15 min, then 5 min uncovered.
Spinach. Wilt in butter, squeeze dry, chop roughly.
Royale. Whisk eggs, cream and milk; season lightly (salmon is salty), add chopped dill.
Fill. Scatter spinach, salmon pieces and grated Gruyère into the case; pour royale to the rim.
Bake. 160 °C 35–40 min until just set with a slight wobble; core ≥ 75 °C. Rest 20 min, cut 10 slices.
Service. Warm slice to order 160 °C 6–8 min.
Plating. Slice centred on a warm flat plate, dill sprig on top; chosen side alongside.
f565e391.st: Baked quiche: 48 h at 0–4 °C, covered Opened smoked salmon: 48 h at 0–4 °C

c: Sauté. Sweat diced onion, carrots, celery and garlic in olive oil 8 min; add tomato paste and paprika.
Simmer. Add rinsed lentils, chopped tomatoes, stock and sugar; simmer 25 min until lentils collapse.
Blend. Add basil, blend smooth, season with salt and pepper; adjust consistency with stock.
Croutons. Cube bread, toss with olive oil, garlic and salt; bake 160 °C 10–12 min.
Service. Reheat portion to ≥ 75 °C to order; cut lemon into wedges.
Plating. Warm soup bowl on underplate: soup, croutons on top, basil leaf, lemon wedge on the underplate.
93bef588.st: Soup: 72 h at 0–4 °C after blast chilling; frozen 1 month at −18 °C Croutons: 3 days airtight; lemon wedges: 24 h at 0–4 °C

c: Bolognese. Brown mince in olive oil, add onion, carrot, celery, garlic; fry tomato paste, deglaze with wine. Add tomatoes, stock, bay, oregano; simmer 1.5 h.
Béchamel. Butter-flour roux, whisk in hot milk, simmer 5 min; season with salt and nutmeg.
Layer. GN 1/1: bolognese, sheets, béchamel, parmesan — repeat 4 layers; finish béchamel, mozzarella, parmesan.
Bake. Covered 180 °C 40 min, uncovered 15 min until golden; core ≥ 75 °C. Rest 30 min, cut 10 portions.
Service. Reheat portion to order 180 °C 12–15 min, core ≥ 75 °C.
Plating. Lift portion with a spatula onto a warm oval gratin dish or deep plate; basil leaves on top.
609069a4.st: Bolognese, béchamel: 72 h at 0–4 °C Baked lasagna: 72 h at 0–4 °C; portioned and frozen −18 °C 2 months

c: Peppers. Roast red peppers at 220 °C 20 min until blistered; steam covered, peel, deseed, cut into strips.
Prep. Dice tomatoes and cucumbers 1.5 cm, slice onion finely, chop parsley; keep separately chilled.
Dress. To order, combine vegetables with peppers, salt, sunflower oil and cider vinegar; toss gently.
Cheese. Grate sirene finely just before service.
Plating. Deep salad bowl: dressed vegetables mounded, generous dome of grated sirene on top, parsley sprinkle.
479ce272.st: Cut vegetables: 12 h at 0–4 °C, unsalted Roasted peppers: 72 h at 0–4 °C
